title: Let pain teach what comfort keeps hiding
summary: Pain becomes medicine when it uncovers what comfort hides. Let pain uncover dependence comfort concealed.
takeaway: Let pain uncover dependence comfort concealed.
lifeApplication: When ache rises, do not numb it first; ask what comfort has hidden and confess where you cannot act without the Creator.

source.shortMeaning: Pain becomes medicine when it uncovers what comfort hides.
source.lifeApplication: When the ache rises in the body, do not numb it first. Sit one minute longer and ask what it is uncovering.
